remarks: Welcome to this exquisite 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome in the heart of New Canaan's Prides Crossing. This beautifully renovated Georgian gem offers luxurious living with modern amenities and elegant design. Enjoy the open-concept living area with a wood-burning fireplace, updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a private garden patio perfect for relaxation. The home boasts hardwood floors, custom lighting, and thoughtful updates throughout. Upstairs, find a spacious primary suite and two additional bedrooms. A finished lower level provides extra living space and storage. Residents of Prides Crossing enjoy access to a private pool and clubhouse. Located just minutes from town, parks, shopping, and the train station, this home has the perfect blend of suburban charm and urban convenience, all within an hour of Manhattan.
